{{Top}}
{{Quote|Doonium has been the metal alloy of choice for nearly 10 centuries in capital starship construction. The distinctive white-gray cast of the battlecraft constructed with doonium has become synonymous with serious naval power.|Harod Crimmler of the Historical Battleship Preservation Association, as quoted in Imperial Defense Daily|<ref name="TCSWE">[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 10]]</ref>}}
[[File:Doonium.png|thumb|Doonium]]

'''Doonium''' was a heavy metal primarily used in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hull construction. It gave ships such as those in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] their characteristic white-gray color.<ref name="GNN10">{{JournalCite|10|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> The Empire granted exclusive mining contracts to companies like [[Turlin Corp]] to provide the needed ore.<ref name="SoSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>

Between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] experienced a [[Rawmat shortage of 1–2 ABY|raw materials shortage]] that included a shortage of doonium. As a result, many ships languished in spacedock without proper hull plating. To clear space in the Kuat drydocks, a flotilla of [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] was equipped with red [[Havod/Legends|havod]] alloy hulls instead of the traditional doonium.<ref name="GNN10" />

One source for the metal was the mines of the [[Thrugii Asteroid Belt]] in the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]].<ref name="The Black Sands of Socorro">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref> Other sources included [[Dor]]<ref name="Endor and the Moddell Sector">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref> and [[Atraken/Legends|Atraken]].<ref name="Insider67">{{InsiderCite|67|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:4:14}}</ref>
